description: This source file defines the CanvasScheme enum, including constants for scheme identifiers, a URL construction function, and a MIME type determination function based on file extensions.

methods.name: makeURL
methods.description: Constructs a URL with the specified session and optional path, using the scheme defined in CanvasScheme.

methods.name: mimeType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type string corresponding to a given file extension.
